subject: english-literature
title: Hero, Mentor, Sidekick
welcome_lead: Some character shapes appear again and again. Meet the archetypes.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on character archetypes.
final_note: You can now name the classic archetypes in any story.

concepts.def: Brave figure on a journey or quest.
Wise guide who teaches the hero.

walkthroughs.body_html: From Star Wars to Harry Potter, a young hero is guided by a wise mentor — think Obi-Wan or Dumbledore.
The sidekick stands by the hero — Ron and Hermione, Samwise to Frodo. Loyalty and contrast are key.
A trickster like Loki or Puck disrupts plans, creating chaos that drives the story forward.
